detailed_description: The Step Line Chart Generator creates an ECharts step line chart from a small editable table. You can enter category and value rows manually, load sample data, or import a simple CSV or TXT file where each line contains a label and a numeric value separated by a comma or tab. Chart settings include title, color theme, step position, legend, grid, and area fill. The live preview can be downloaded as PNG or SVG.
usage_steps: Edit the category and value rows in the data table, or load the included sample data.
Optionally import a simple CSV or TXT file with two columns: label and value.
Set the chart title, color theme, step position, legend, grid, and area fill options.
Check the live chart preview as the data and settings change.
Download the chart as PNG or SVG.
usage_examples: Show a value that stays constant between scheduled updates.
Plot milestone counts across a sequence of project stages.
Compare weekly inventory levels from a two-column CSV export.
Create a PNG or SVG step chart for a status report.
